source: Seeded 2026-10-16. Every entry below was checked against the official source named in its source_url on that date; the fact checked (number, hours, languages, cost) is quoted next to the source in the entry's verification_note. Entries that could NOT be confirmed from an official source today carry verification_status "needs_verification", say why, and are excluded from agent results until a human re-verifies them (AGENTS.md safety rule 6). This directory is support options, not a crisis service: at HIGH/IMMINENT risk the deterministic crisis flow always wins.
disclaimer: Manovia is a self-help companion, not a crisis service, and this directory is information, not a referral. Numbers and hours drift: each entry names its source and the date a person last checked it. In an emergency call your local emergency number first.

resources.name: Tele-MANAS (Government of India)
resources.description: India's national tele-mental-health service, run by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. Trained counsellors answer calls, with referral to specialists. Launched 10 October 2022; cells in every state and union territory.
resources.language_note: English, Hindi and 20+ Indian regional languages, per the official site.
resources.verification_note: Numbers 14416 and 1-800-891-4416 and 24x7 availability read from the official Tele-MANAS site (telemanas.mohfw.gov.in) on 2026-10-16; programme run by MoHFW per dghs.mohfw.gov.in National Mental Health Programme page.

resources.name: KIRAN Mental Health Rehabilitation Helpline
resources.description: Toll-free helpline of the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. Early screening, first aid, psychological support, distress management and referral.
resources.verification_note: Number 1800-599-0019, 24x7 operation and the 13 named languages (Hindi, Assamese, Tamil, Marathi, Odia, Telugu, Malayalam, Gujarati, Punjabi, Kannada, Bengali, Urdu, English) are from the ministry's PIB release (prid=1652240).

resources.name: iCALL Psychosocial Helpline (TISS, Mumbai)
resources.description: Free telephone, email and chat counselling run by the School of Human Ecology, Tata Institute of Social Sciences. Anyone in emotional or psychological distress, any age.
resources.verification_note: Number 9152987821, email icall@tiss.ac.in and Mon-Sat 08:00-21:00 hours read from the service's own site icallhelpline.org on 2026-10-16.

resources.name: AASRA (Mumbai, takes calls nationally)
resources.description: Suicide-prevention and emotional-support helpline, a unit of Befrienders Worldwide/Samaritans, run since 1998.
resources.verification_note: 24x7 number +91-22-27546669 read from the 'GET HELP' panel of aasra.info on 2026-10-16. The older widely-cited mobile +91-9820466726 appears on the site's contact page as a staff member's number, so the published 24x7 line is used here.

resources.name: Vandrevala Foundation Helpline
resources.description: Free 24x7 crisis-intervention helpline by phone and WhatsApp; counsellors handle calls in English, Hindi and major Indian regional languages.
resources.language_note: English, Hindi and major Indian regional languages, per the foundation.
resources.verification_note: Number +91 9999 666 555, 24x7x365 availability, call and WhatsApp, and languages read from vandrevalafoundation.com/free-counseling on 2026-10-16.

resources.name: Fortis Stress Helpline (Mental Health & Behavioural Sciences)
resources.description: 24x7 multilingual helpline run by Fortis Healthcare's Department of Mental Health and Behavioural Sciences for emotional distress, including exam stress.
resources.language_note: 14 languages including Assamese, Bengali, English, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu and Rajasthani, per the department.
resources.audience: everyone in India; students and parents
resources.verification_note: Number +918376804102, 24x7 operation and the multilingual team are stated in Fortis Healthcare press releases (fortishealthcare.com) and in the Live Love Laugh helpline listing, both checked 2026-10-16.

resources.name: Lifeline Foundation (Kolkata)
resources.description: Kolkata-based non-profit, the only organisation of its kind in West Bengal per its own site, offering free, anonymous, non-judgemental emotional support by phone since 1996.
resources.audience: Kolkata and West Bengal; takes calls from across India
resources.verification_note: Numbers +91 9163940404 and +91 9088030303 with '14x7 crisis helplines' read from lifelinefoundation.in on 2026-10-16; landline hours 10:00-18:00 daily from the AASRA state directory (aasra.info/helpline.html).

resources.name: Jadavpur University Centre for Counselling Services and Studies in Self-Development
resources.description: Confidential counselling for Jadavpur University students, free of charge, on matters from addiction to career choice. Located on the 3rd floor of Darshan Bhavan, main campus.
resources.hours: Office hours (not published on the page)
resources.verification_note: Name, free confidential service, Darshan Bhavan location, extension 2457-2481 and email ccsssju@gmail.com read from the university's own page on 2026-10-16. The page does not publish opening hours, so hours are marked unpublished rather than guessed.

resources.name: IIT Kharagpur Students' Counselling Centre
resources.description: Confidential one-to-one and group counselling, crisis intervention and psychiatric services for IIT Kharagpur students; after-hours cover through the campus Quick Response Team and B.C. Roy Help Desk.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 10:00-13:00 and 16:00-20:00; after-hours via campus QRT 81002/81003
resources.verification_note: Centre, phone +91 3222 281173 and email cc@adm.iitkgp.ac.in read from the Counselling Centre's own site on 2026-10-16; visiting hours Mon-Fri 10:00-13:00 and 16:00-20:00 and the after-hours numbers 81002/81003 from the SARTH student portal (sarth.iitkgp.ac.in).

resources.name: Therapize India
resources.description: Free directory and matching tool for Indian therapists and counsellors: set your location and budget, get curated matches. 90+ practitioners listed at verification; practitioners pass a due-diligence check per the platform.
resources.cost_note: Directory browsing and matching are free; the therapist sets their own fee.
resources.audience: anyone in India looking for a therapist
resources.verification_note: Free matchmaking tool, 90+ practitioners, budget and location filters read from the platform's own homepage on 2026-10-16.

resources.name: YourDOST
resources.description: Indian online counselling platform: anonymous text chat with a panel of psychologists, counsellors and life coaches in 20+ Indian languages; voice and video sessions are paid.
resources.cost_note: Free text chat; paid voice/video sessions.
resources.audience: anyone in India; also runs programmes for colleges and employers
resources.verification_note: 24/7 access, 20+ Indian languages, anonymous chat and the expert panel read from yourdost.com on 2026-10-16; free-text/paid-voice split is the platform's long-standing freemium model and was confirmed in the site's own descriptions.

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.description: US national 24/7 lifeline for mental-health, substance-use and suicide crisis. Free and confidential; call or text 988, or chat online. Spanish services and ASL videophone available; interpreters in 240+ languages for callers.
resources.language_note: English and Spanish directly; 240+ languages via interpreters, per SAMHSA.
resources.verification_note: 'Call or text 988, chat at 988lifeline.org', 24/7 and free read from 988lifeline.org on 2026-10-16; English/Spanish and 240+ interpreter languages from SAMHSA's 988 FAQ (samhsa.gov/mental-health/988/faqs).

resources.name: Crisis Text Line
resources.description: Free, 24/7 text-based crisis support: text HOME to 741741 and a trained volunteer Crisis Counselor replies. English and Spanish.
resources.verification_note: 'Text HOME to 741741', free, 24/7, confidential, English & Spanish read from crisistextline.org on 2026-10-16.

resources.name: SAMHSA National Helpline
resources.description: Free, confidential, 24/7 treatment-referral and information service (English and Spanish) for mental-health and substance-use disorders; connects callers to local services, including sliding-scale options.
resources.audience: individuals and families in the US
resources.verification_note: Number 1-800-662-HELP (4357), free, confidential, 24/7, 365 days, English and Spanish read from samhsa.gov/find-help/national-helpline on 2026-10-16.

resources.name: NAMI HelpLine
resources.description: Free nationwide peer-support service: information, resource referrals and support for people living with a mental-health condition, families and caregivers. Not a crisis line.
resources.audience: people with mental-health conditions, families, caregivers
resources.verification_note: Number 1-800-950-NAMI (62644), text NAMI to 62640, Mon-Fri 10am-10pm ET read from nami.org/nami-helpline on 2026-10-16.

resources.name: NAMI Connection & Family Support Groups
resources.description: Free, peer-led support groups for adults living with mental-health conditions (NAMI Connection) and for family and friends (NAMI Family Support Group); in-person and online, findable by ZIP code.
resources.audience: adults with mental-health conditions and their families
resources.verification_note: Peer-led, free, NAMI Connection and Family Support Group formats and the in-person/online mix read from nami.org/support-groups on 2026-10-16.

resources.name: DBSA Support Groups (Depression and Bipolar Support Alliance)
resources.description: Free peer-led support groups for people living with depression or bipolar disorder, online and in person; 20,000+ meetings a year per the organisation.
resources.audience: people with depression or bipolar disorder; friends and family
resources.verification_note: Free, peer-led, in-person and online support groups for depression and bipolar disorder read from dbsalliance.org/support on 2026-10-16.

resources.name: Open Path Psychotherapy Collective
resources.description: Nonprofit directory of therapists offering reduced-rate sessions to members: one-time US$65 lifetime membership, then individual sessions US$40-70 (couples/family US$40-80; student interns US$30). Serves people who are uninsured, underinsured or cannot afford market rates.
resources.cost_note: One-time US$65 lifetime membership; sessions US$40-70.
resources.audience: US and Canada; household income under US$100k and uninsured/underinsured
resources.verification_note: US$65 one-time lifetime membership and US$40-70 individual session range read from openpathcollective.org/pricing-and-eligibility-for-affordable-therapy on 2026-10-16.

resources.name: Samaritans
resources.description: Free, confidential emotional support any time, day or night, for anyone who needs to talk. Welsh-language line 0808 164 0123 (19:00-23:00).
resources.audience: everyone in the UK and Ireland
resources.verification_note: 'Call us free any time, from any phone, on 116 123' and the free-to-call confirmation read from samaritans.org on 2026-10-16; Welsh line hours from the same page's linked Mind helplines listing.

resources.name: Mind Support Line and Infoline
resources.description: Mind's support line is a safe space to talk about mental health and work out next steps; the Infoline answers questions about mental-health problems, local help, treatment and advocacy.
resources.cost_note: 0300 numbers are charged at standard geographic call rates, not freephone.
resources.verification_note: Support line 0300 102 1234 and Infoline 0300 123 3393, open 9am-6pm Mon-Fri except bank holidays, read from mind.org.uk/information-support/helplines on 2026-10-16.

resources.name: NHS Talking Therapies (England)
resources.description: Free talking therapies on the NHS for anxiety and depression (CBT, counselling, guided self-help). Adults in England can refer themselves without seeing a GP; a course is typically 8-16 sessions.
resources.hours: Self-referral anytime online; services contact you within a few weeks
resources.audience: adults in England (18+, or 16-17 in some areas)
resources.verification_note: Free access, self-referral without a GP, and the service finder read from nhs.uk/tests-and-treatments/talking-therapies on 2026-10-16; 18+ (16-17 in some areas) from the NHS self-referral finder page.

resources.name: BACP Therapist Directory
resources.description: Searchable directory of counsellors and psychotherapists who are registered or accredited members of the British Association for Counselling and Psychotherapy; filter by location, service and specialism. Fees are set by each therapist.
resources.cost_note: Private practice; each therapist sets their own fee.
resources.audience: anyone in the UK seeking a registered therapist
resources.verification_note: Directory scope (registered/accredited members only), search by location/services/specialisms and the registration standard read from bacp.co.uk on 2026-10-16.

resources.name: Find A Helpline
resources.description: Global directory of verified helplines and support lines in 130+ countries, searchable by topic (suicide, anxiety, depression, abuse and more). Partner organisations verify their own information with the directory.
resources.language_note: Local services in each country's own languages.
resources.verification_note: 130+ countries, verified partner helplines and phone/text/chat contact modes read from findahelpline.com on 2026-10-16.

resources.name: Befrienders Worldwide
resources.description: Global network of emotional-support and suicide-prevention centres in 30+ countries; the site's centre finder lists the nearest listening service by country.
resources.language_note: Local centres serve their own languages.
resources.verification_note: Global network and the centre finder read from befrienders.org on 2026-10-16; the 32-country figure is from IASP's listing of the network (iasp.info).

resources.name: University of Calcutta counselling cell
resources.description: Campus counselling for University of Calcutta students. Contact details and hours could not be confirmed from an official university page on the verification date.
resources.verification_note: No official University of Calcutta page with a current counselling-cell phone number, email or hours could be found on 2026-10-16; the university homepage does not publish one. Excluded from agent results until a human verifies a contact channel.

resources.name: Bengali-language peer support group (Kolkata)
resources.description: A Bengali-speaking peer support group meeting in Kolkata. No official listing with a verifiable organiser, meeting schedule or contact channel could be found on the verification date.
resources.verification_note: Searches on 2026-10-16 surfaced only commercial platforms and national helplines; no official page for a Bengali-language Kolkata peer support group with a schedule and organiser could be confirmed. Excluded until verified.

resources.name: West Bengal exam-stress helpline for students
resources.description: A state-run exam-stress line distinct from Tele-MANAS. Could not be verified: the West Bengal Health & Family Welfare helpline found (033-2357-6000) is a general health line, not a mental-health or exam-stress service.
resources.verification_note: wbhealth.gov.in lists a general help line (033-2357-6000) but no dedicated exam-stress or student mental-health line on 2026-10-16. Students are routed to Tele-MANAS (in-tele-manas) instead, which is verified. Excluded until a dedicated line is confirmed.
